The simple result of Problem 14(a) is called the “Nested Interval Theorem.” It
may be used to give alternative proofs of Theorems 1 and 2. The appropriate
reasoning, outlined in the next two problems, illustrates a general method, called
a “bisection argument.”

*18. A number x is called an almost upper bound for A if there are only
finitely many numbers y in A with y > x. An almost lower bound is
defined similarly.
(a) Find all almost upper bounds and almost lower bounds of the sets in
